synopsis: EVIDENT 2 is a Vinnova follow-on whose record was updated on 10 June 2026; its work remained ongoing in 2026 [f1556]. The glossary independently restates that the program was still running in 2026, while Chapter 2 also lists its capability building as ongoing [f15712, f1929]. Its scope covers simulation credibility, physical correlation and eventual regulatory acceptance; the supplied facts do not establish completed regulatory acceptance or a completion date [f1557, f1556, f1929].
